clues.text: Teaching the crowds in parables, Jesus said this is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
In a parable of Jesus, this tiny seed is planted and grows into the largest of all garden plants.
Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like this kind of seed that a man planted in his field.
In a parable of Jesus, a man tossed it into his garden, and birds nested in its branches.
After His disciples failed to drive out a demon, Jesus said faith this small could move a mountain.
When the apostles asked Jesus to increase their faith, He said faith this small could uproot a mulberry tree.
Jesus told the parable of this seed right before comparing God's kingdom to leaven mixed into flour.
